name: Duvo
description: Duvo grounds operational outcomes in reviewed process evidence and supports approved cross-system execution with agents, queues, approvals, files, webhooks, and MCP.

skills.name: Run operational workflows
skills.description: Start and inspect agent-backed runs across enterprise systems, files, portals, and approvals.

skills.name: Manage queues
skills.description: Create durable cases for invoices, supplier work, alerts, claims, files, or other operational intake.

skills.name: Human approval gates
skills.description: Pause sensitive actions for review and resume after an authorized human response.

skills.name: Official command-line interface
skills.description: Script Duvo runs, cases, approvals, files, and inspections from the shell. Install with `npm install -g @duvoai/cli`; binary `duvo`; npm package https://www.npmjs.com/package/@duvoai/cli; guide https://www.duvo.ai/cli.md.
